From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pegasus leg reassignment & on-site itinerary — Zenith workshop

Hi Rachel / Aurelia team,

Quick context: Zenith's execs (Tom, two VPs) are arriving on Monday 3/20 for the workshop; we've had a carrier schedule change that splits the original single-leg arrival into two separate connections with a long layover in PDX. That creates a risk for the morning kickoff and complicates ground logistics.

Can you please:
- Propose rebook options that consolidate arrivals into the 07:30–09:30 arrival window on 3/20 (SFO local).
- Prioritize: Tom Harper (seat + 1 carry-on) and Zenith CEO (aisle/tier seating).
- Note any fare differences and ETA for confirmation.

Attached the current pax roster for the group (initial_pax_list.csv).

We'd like an option by EOD PT today so we can confirm transfers and update invites. Ben and Monica are looped to approve any < $350 fare uplift; anything higher will need a PO from Tom.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Travel & Events Lead | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: initial_pax_list.csv (CSV, 1.2 KB)

From: Rachel Park <rachel.park@aurelia.co>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Harper <tom.harper@zenithcorp.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pegasus leg reassignment & on-site itinerary — Zenith workshop

Vanessa / Ben / Monica,

Thanks for the head's up. We've pulled the PNRs and have three clean rebook candidates that consolidate the inbound legs into the requested 07:30–09:30 window. Key notes:

Option A (recommended): Direct through SFO on AS 612 arriving 08:10 — small fare difference ($210 total uplift for the group), seats available in premium economy for execs.
Option B: Earlier connection via SEA, arrives 07:45 — slightly longer ground transfer, no seat upgrade availability without surcharge.
Option C: Keep existing times but move to priority connection (protect baggage + shorter minimum connection) — no fare change but higher risk.

I've attached the detailed options (aur_rebook_options.pdf) with per-passenger line items and fare uplifts. If you confirm Option A, we can issue immediately and assign charters for the airport pickup window 08:30–09:00.

Let us know which option you want and which passenger(s) need executive seats. If you need us to hold inventory while approvals come through, we can hold for 4 hours.

— Rachel
Aurelia Logistics
Attachments: aur_rebook_options.pdf (PDF, 84 KB)
